inputs.text: [excited] HAT… seh… gop… TER… iks. A name in three pieces. "Hatzego" comes from Hațeg, a region of Romania, [serious] where its bones were found. [curious] "Pteryx," in Greek, is wing. And "thambema" means monster.
[happily] Exactly. [serious] Careful: not a dinosaur — a flying reptile. It lived sixty-six million years ago, [amazed] on a lost island out at sea.
[calm] Yes, cut off from the rest of the world. [pauses] And out there, almost nothing was like anywhere else.
